name: io.github.jordanburke/reddit-mcp-server
description: E-commerce research MCP: scrape Reddit, Facebook groups (public & private), and Amazon product reviews, full Reddit read/write, and build Schwartz customer personas.

environmentVariables.name: REDDIT_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Reddit app client ID (optional - live Reddit data; without it, reads come from RSS feeds and the Arctic Shift archive)

environmentVariables.name: REDDIT_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Reddit app client secret

environmentVariables.name: REDDIT_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Reddit username (required for write operations)

environmentVariables.name: REDDIT_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Reddit password (required for write operations)

environmentVariables.name: REDDIT_AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Authentication mode: auto, authenticated, or anonymous

environmentVariables.name: REDDIT_SAFE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Write safeguards: off, standard (default), or strict

environmentVariables.name: REDDIT_BOT_DISCLOSURE
environmentVariables.description: Bot disclosure footer: auto or off (default)

environmentVariables.name: REDDIT_BOT_FOOTER
environmentVariables.description: Custom bot footer text (used with REDDIT_BOT_DISCLOSURE=auto)

environmentVariables.name: FACEBOOK_COOKIE
environmentVariables.description: Full Cookie header from a logged-in facebook.com browser (must include c_user and xs). Required to scrape private groups you are a member of.

environmentVariables.name: FACEBOOK_ENGINE
environmentVariables.description: Facebook scraping engine: auto (default), http (lightweight), or browser (Playwright; best for private groups)

environmentVariables.name: FACEBOOK_MIN_DELAY_MS
environmentVariables.description: Minimum delay in ms between Facebook requests (anti-bot pacing, default 4000)

environmentVariables.name: FACEBOOK_HEADLESS
environmentVariables.description: Run the Playwright browser engine headless: true (default) or false

environmentVariables.name: AMAZON_COOKIE
environmentVariables.description: Full Cookie header from a logged-in amazon.com browser. Optional - lets the scraper page deeper into a product's full review history (logged-out only sees a handful).

environmentVariables.name: AMAZON_ENGINE
environmentVariables.description: Amazon scraping engine: auto (default), http (lightweight), browser (Playwright), or api (paid reviews API)

environmentVariables.name: AMAZON_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for a paid Amazon reviews API (Unwrangle or Rainforest). The most reliable path; bypasses anti-bot and login walls.

environmentVariables.name: AMAZON_API_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Which reviews API the AMAZON_API_KEY belongs to: unwrangle (default) or rainforest

environmentVariables.name: AMAZON_MARKETPLACE
environmentVariables.description: Default Amazon marketplace TLD when only an ASIN is given: com (default), co.uk, de, ca, fr, etc.

environmentVariables.name: AMAZON_MIN_DELAY_MS
environmentVariables.description: Minimum delay in ms between Amazon requests (anti-bot pacing, default 3000)

environmentVariables.name: META_ADS_COOKIE
environmentVariables.description: Optional facebook.com Cookie header for the Meta Ad Library. Not required (the Ad Library is public); by default it reuses FACEBOOK_COOKIE. A session only smooths anti-bot.

environmentVariables.name: META_ADS_ENGINE
environmentVariables.description: Meta Ad Library engine: auto (default), http (lightweight, brittle), browser (Playwright - most robust), or api (paid provider)

environmentVariables.name: META_ADS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional paid Ad Library API key (ScrapeCreators). The most reliable path at scale; handles proxies and token rotation.

environmentVariables.name: META_ADS_COUNTRY
environmentVariables.description: Default Ad Library country as an ISO code (US default), or ALL
